coverage_note: Of the 288 overlay clips: 79 use a nonzero episode (samples hold episode 0 only); 7 episode-0 clips were rendered from reviewed or repaired data not in the samples; 52 episode-0 clips were rendered with the headless Rerun viewer (109 Rerun renders overall, same geometry, different shading); about 150 episode-0 clips were made with the shipped OpenCV renderers and reproduce almost pixel for pixel. Counts from the 2026-10-12 review of the site render logs; the audit counts above were not recomputed.
sample_coverage_note: Every catalogued clip dataset has a sample; all archives contain episode 0 only. All 41 datasets lacking samples are DataClaw. A sample URL does not imply the website clip episode is available.
conclusion: All website projects have recipes and representative samples run after the recorded fixes; exact reproduction of every site clip is not possible with the published sample inputs and current renderer coverage.

The site's rby1/modpack clips were rendered with the headless Rerun viewer (lerobot_rerun_viz.py --viz-config config/rby1_modpack.json), not a separate tool. This release renders the same views and placement with the OpenCV multiview renderer; only the look differs, and the head pair is drawn as KB4 fisheye here where the Rerun clip used pinhole. See the recipes.json rby1/modpack note and README section 'Reproduction coverage'.

README section 'Reproduction coverage' (Recovered commands) and the RECIPES.md notes. The site commands were recovered from the source render logs after this audit and the recipes encode them (tamen fitted eef poses, freetacman multiview route, muse umift profile, legato tile height 384); legato's 3x decode upscale cannot be expressed in a recipe, and molmoact has no command on disk (per-episode intrinsics drive both tools).

fixed_in_this_audit: Added missing pandas dependency; fresh Python 3.10 and 3.12 installations and representative renders pass.
Replaced nonexistent quickstart dataset with verified public UMI and ALOHA downloads; added stdlib sample downloader.
Made selftest portable and propagated every render failure to the process exit status.
Fixed relative output paths, raw-video duration/episode boundaries, invalid inputs and truncated-output success reporting.
Preserved malformed datasets in summaries, handled discovery symlink cycles, and fixed partial episode calibration fallback.
Multiview now honors episode gripper variants and existing OpenNeo static-camera/wrist-retarget transforms.
RB-Y1 recipes handle both public head-stream names and newer stereo names; all four views render.
Dexora axes preserve their color and explicit alpha under the default look.
Driver episode-specific eef transforms take precedence over dataset-wide fallback values.

samples.no_overlay: inspire_*: the Inspire RH56 hand model and CAD are not published and the release records no fingertip width; xhand_*: the XHAND1 CAD placed at the UR5 flange pose of the DexUMI calibration through the nominal OAK-1 W lens does not land on the replayed hand; the camera-to-flange transform needs a fit first
the release publishes no camera intrinsics and no camera-to-hand transform for the palm cameras, and the LEAP Hand V2 has no CAD here
the release publishes no camera-to-tool translation (the fitted camera_in_eef has zero translation), no gripper width and no CAD

the wrist camera-to-flange transform is a prior, never fitted: the WidowX 250 S CAD does not land on the real gripper and the flange frame itself falls at the bottom edge of the image; withheld until it is fitted
